title: Navigating Cultural Chasms: Exploring and Unlocking the Cultural POV of Text-To-Image Models
findings: The paper includes religion as a key cultural domain and provides a framework and dataset (CulText2I) to analyze the visual representation of religious concepts. The findings demonstrate that Text-to-Image (TTI) models visualize concepts like 'wedding' differently based on the language used in the prompt (e.g., Hindi, Chinese, Arabic), reflecting distinct cultural and likely religious variations. The study focuses more on the methods for unlocking and evaluating this cultural content rather than specific findings about any single religion.

measurement_description: Visual representation of religious concepts (e.g., God, wedding, church, specific faiths) in images generated by Text-to-Image models to evaluate their embedded cultural knowledge. The benchmark uses a cultural ontology where 'Religion' is one of twelve domains.
